continuous_observation.command_template: set -eu; : "${NEW_VERSION_ID:?missing NEW_VERSION_ID}"; : > /tmp/oddspark-r7-tail.ndjson; : > /tmp/oddspark-r7-tail.stderr; CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=e72c232411bedeed357f3c73e4f4f0aa WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/oddspark-r7-tail-wrangler.log npx --no-install wrangler tail oddspark --config /Volumes/fast/Github/oddspark/wrangler.toml --format json --status ok --status error --status canceled --version-id "$NEW_VERSION_ID" > /tmp/oddspark-r7-tail.ndjson 2> /tmp/oddspark-r7-tail.stderr & tail_pid=$!; trap 'kill -INT "$tail_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' INT TERM HUP; sleep 300; kill -INT "$tail_pid"; set +e; wait "$tail_pid"; tail_rc=$?; set -e; test "$tail_rc" -eq 0 -o "$tail_rc" -eq 130; ! grep -Eqi 'unauthorized|forbidden|failed to create tail|connection.*(closed|failed)' /tmp/oddspark-r7-tail.stderr; jq -c . /tmp/oddspark-r7-tail.ndjson >/dev/null
continuous_observation.output_schema: one continuous 300-second parent process; Wrangler tail remains alive until the commanded interrupt; stderr may be empty but contains no connection/auth failure; stdout file is zero or more newline-delimited JSON objects; every nonblank line independently parses as JSON
continuous_observation.parser: For each NDJSON event require outcome in [ok,error,canceled], exceptions array, logs array, eventTimestamp numeric, and no malformed line. Count outcomes exactly. Require error_count=0, canceled_count=0, and total exception objects=0. Bind comes from Wrangler --version-id NEW_VERSION_ID; retain NEW_VERSION_ID, start/end monotonic timestamps, both files and hashes. Zero events is valid only as 'no invocation observed', never as proof of traffic or provider inactivity.
continuous_observation.same_id_polling: If the outer command yields, continue the exact outer ID. The internal tail PID must never be recreated. The 300-second sleep is one uninterrupted interval; interruption, early tail exit, or missing terminal result is ambiguous.
continuous_observation.terminal_ambiguity: NEW_VERSION_ID missing; tail exits before 300 seconds; kill/wait state unrecognized; malformed NDJSON; connection/auth failure; lost outer ID; recreated tail PID; interrupted window; or incomplete retained files/terminal result.
continuous_observation.honest_contract: This proves only the outcomes/exceptions of invocations observed by a version-filtered real-time tail during the retained interval. Invocation status is not HTTP response status. It cannot support a zero-5xx claim. The three smoke GETs separately prove their exact HTTP statuses and content contracts.

Deterministically extract the embedded reviewed runner, verify its exact SHA-256, and launch it in retained tmux. These are preparation/execution mechanics, not an ordinal.

The embedded runner resolves every inventory entry directly from this packet and invokes its command or command_template exactly once and strictly in order. No agent interprets or independently reconstructs an ordinal during live execution.

Each ordinal is one child process of the retained runner parent. The runner waits for that same PID to terminate; it never creates a replacement. Ordinal 21 itself preserves exactly one ordinal parent and one Wrangler tail child for 300 seconds.

The runner captures complete per-command stdout/stderr, timestamps, terminal exit/signal, byte counts and SHA-256 hashes, applies only the retained parser implementation, and writes evidence after every terminal ordinal only to ignored governor-session paths.
Only ordinal 14 may produce NEW_VERSION_ID, exactly once. The retained runner exports only that parsed lowercase UUID to later templates.
